D.t: Hannah Pingree leads by 13.4 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 99,640 votes; a one point swing is about 3,704 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +5.8 and D +20.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +11.4. Your best recent poll is Maine People's Resource Center (D) at D +14.3; your worst is Marist College at R +2.0. 12 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Cumberland, a projected net 78,939 votes; York, a projected net 22,296 votes; Knox, a projected net 6,375 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Penobscot, R +6.6, 10.4% of the vote; Kennebec, D +2.3, 8.9% of the vote; Androscoggin, R +1.0, 7.1% of the vote; Oxford, R +6.5, 4.1% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Hannah Pingree runs furthest behind in Aroostook, Piscataquis, Somerset. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 95% of voters, 52 to 40, where a 5 point gain is worth 4.75 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 76% of voters, 54 to 38, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.83 points; Voters without a degree, 60% of voters, 48 to 43, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.02 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Hannah Pingree: Immigration voters 19 to 73, Voters who can afford daily costs 43 to 49, Men 47 to 45. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$1.2M cash against $395K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
